name: Paper Garden
author: Wevir
css: [data-main-card] { background-image: radial-gradient(ellipse at 94% 6%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 13%, transparent), transparent 46%), radial-gradient(ellipse at 8% 96%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 7%, transparent), transparent 42%); } [data-composer-box] { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 32%, var(--border)) !important; box-shadow: 0 3px 20px color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground) 5%, transparent) !important; } [data-user-message-bubble] { border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 16%, transparent); } [data-code-block] { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 24%, var(--border)) !important; }
